dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent structures: one high-contrast circular ring at the upper-central dorsal region with a sharp dark-to-white gradient; a second, slightly smaller elliptical ring positioned posterior-dorsal to the first; and a third, larger, low-contrast diffuse 'O' shape located ventrally to the first two.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Core concentration of high-intensity pixels is localized in the posterior-dorsal section, forming a saturated region where individual gradients are lost. Scattered low-intensity pixel clusters are located in the center-mass area, forming the cores of faint annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the two sharpest dorsal rings and the primary ventral diffuse ring form a triangular spatial configuration with an obtuse angle at the ventral vertex.
